name: This Windows PC, Camoufox, pinned device per account
description: Today's working setup: every account on matt's one Windows 11 PC in Vietnam, Camoufox via log-cli, 2Captcha residential proxy per account. Baseline.

name: boat.dev: one Linux VM per account
description: One persistent boat.dev Ubuntu VM (EU, no GPU, software rendering, 60fps live desktop, per-second billing, $20/mo minimum, stopped VMs snapshot and don't bill) per account, running log-cli + Camoufox, browser egress through the account's 2Captcha residential proxy instead of boat's datacenter IPv4.

name: boat.dev: one VM hosting many isolated account containers
description: Fewer, larger boat.dev VMs, each running many accounts in separate containers/profiles with their own pinned device, cookies and 2Captcha residential proxy. Cheaper per account than one VM each, but accounts share the VM's CPU, kernel and software renderer.

name: Self-managed cheap VPS/bare metal (Hetzner/OVH) with containers per account
description: Rent own servers (Listaro already ran AdsPower on a Hetzner CPX41, ~12 concurrent profiles per 16 GB), run log-cli + Camoufox per container with Xvfb/VNC viewing, 2Captcha residential egress. No GPU unless a GPU server is rented.

name: Cloud Windows VM with a GPU per account or small group
description: Windows VMs with a real or virtual GPU (AWS g4dn/g5, Azure NV, Paperspace, Shadow PC) running log-cli + Camoufox, residential proxy egress.

name: GPU sandbox / GPU cloud browser (Daytona GPU, Kernel GPU browsers, Modal)
description: Managed sandboxes or hosted headful browsers with a real datacenter GPU in the rendering path, one per account, BYO residential proxy.

name: Managed cloud browser vendor (Browserbase, Kernel, Steel, Hyperbrowser, Anchor)
description: Hosted stealth Chromium per account with persistent contexts, live view, BYO proxy, driven over CDP.

name: Commercial anti-detect browser on servers (AdsPower/Multilogin/GoLogin/Octo/Kameleo)
description: Replace Camoufox with a commercial anti-detect profile per account running headless on servers via its API (what Listaro built: AdsPower + Xvfb on Hetzner, CDP), residential proxy per profile.

name: Cloud Android phone per account (GeeLark, DuoPlus, VMOS)
description: Each account in the platform's mobile app on a cloud Android phone, automated through the vendor API, residential proxy per phone.

name: 2Captcha Browser API (remote cloud browser)
description: 2Captcha's hosted headful Chromium/Firefox over CDP with claimed kernel-level fingerprint spoofing, persistent profiles and its residential proxies.

name: 2Captcha Fingerprint API values injected into Camoufox
description: Keep Camoufox wherever it runs, but source each account's device values from 2Captcha's Fingerprint API ($29-199/mo) instead of BrowserForge.

name: Provider-agnostic environment layer in log-cli, boat as default host, GPU/phone hosts for high-risk accounts
description: Build an environment abstraction in log-cli (environment = host provider + browser engine + device profile + proxy + schedule, stored per account in Twenty) with adapters for boat, self-managed VPS, GPU sandbox and cloud phone. boat is the default cheap host, accounts can move between providers, and every environment runs the same leak/detection test suite before going live.
